import sys, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, VoigtModel, LinearModel
from scipy.signal import savgol_filter

def fit_window(x, y, lo, hi, centers, model_kind="lor", extra_bkg=True):
    m = (x >= lo) & (x <= hi)
    xw, yw = x[m], y[m]
    mod = LinearModel(prefix="bkg_")
    pars = mod.make_params(bkg_slope=0.0, bkg_intercept=float(np.percentile(yw, 10)))
    comps = []
    for i, c in enumerate(centers):
        Mod = LorentzianModel if model_kind == "lor" else VoigtModel
        g = Mod(prefix=f"p{i}_")
        pars.update(g.make_params(center=c["c"], amplitude=c["a"], sigma=c.get("s", 2.0)))
        pars[f"p{i}_center"].set(min=c["c"] - c["w"], max=c["c"] + c["w"])
        pars[f"p{i}_sigma"].set(min=0.3, max=8.0)
        pars[f"p{i}_amplitude"].set(min=0)
        comps.append(g)
    model = mod
    for g in comps:
        model = model + g
    out = model.fit(yw, pars, x=xw)
    return out, xw, yw

def summarize(out, centers):
    res = {}
    for i, c in enumerate(centers):
        p = out.params
        ctr = p[f"p{i}_center"].value; ctr_e = p[f"p{i}_center"].stderr
        sig = p[f"p{i}_sigma"].value; amp = p[f"p{i}_amplitude"].value
        area = np.pi * amp * sig  # Lorentzian area, amplitude = peak height * pi*sigma? (lmfit: amp = height*pi*sigma)
        height = amp / (np.pi * sig)
        res[c["name"]] = dict(center=round(ctr, 3), center_err=round(ctr_e or np.nan, 3),
                              fwhm=round(2 * sig, 3), height=round(height, 1), area=round(area, 1))
    return res

if __name__ == "__main__":
    out_all = {}
    for tag, p in [("day1", sys.argv[1]), ("day2", sys.argv[2])]:
        df = pd.read_csv(p); x = df.shift_cm1.values; y = df.intensity.values
        # Si window
        si_out, _, _ = fit_window(x, y, 505, 540, [dict(name="Si", c=520.5, a=3000, s=2, w=4)])
        # MoS2 window: E2g ~384, A1g ~406
        mos_out, _, _ = fit_window(x, y, 370, 425, [dict(name="E2g", c=384, a=500, s=2, w=4),
                                                    dict(name="A1g", c=406, a=300, s=2, w=4)])
        r = {}
        r.update(summarize(si_out, [dict(name="Si")]))
        r.update(summarize(mos_out, [dict(name="E2g"), dict(name="A1g")]))
        r["Si_fit_redchi"] = round(si_out.redchi, 2)
        r["MoS2_fit_redchi"] = round(mos_out.redchi, 2)
        r["delta_A1g_minus_E2g"] = round(r["A1g"]["center"] - r["E2g"]["center"], 3)
        r["IA1g_over_IE2g_height"] = round(r["A1g"]["height"] / r["E2g"]["height"], 3)
        r["IA1g_over_IE2g_area"] = round(r["A1g"]["area"] / r["E2g"]["area"], 3)
        out_all[tag] = r
        print(tag, json.dumps(r, indent=1))
        # residual noise estimate in a featureless region 450-500 & 550-640 after fit of background only
        m = (x >= 560) & (x <= 640)
        xs, ys = x[m], y[m]
        pf = np.polyfit(xs, ys, 1)
        resid = ys - np.polyval(pf, xs)
        print(f"  noise (std of residual, 560-640 linear detrend): {resid.std():.1f}; per-point sample spacing {np.diff(x).mean():.3f}")
    print()
    print("Si-referenced: Si known at 520.7 cm^-1 (Temple & Hathaway 1973 / standard)")
    for tag in out_all:
        si = out_all[tag]["Si"]["center"]
        e2g = out_all[tag]["E2g"]["center"]; a1g = out_all[tag]["A1g"]["center"]
        print(f"  {tag}: Si offset {si-520.7:+.2f}; E2g corrected {e2g-(si-520.7):.2f}; A1g corrected {a1g-(si-520.7):.2f}")
EOF
